payload.core_mechanism_summary: Scans the array once to count fixed points and detects a pair (i,j) such that a[i]=j and a[j]=i, allowing a swap to gain two fixed points.
payload.rationale: Weak supervision suggests search_permutation_enumeration; the solution does not enumerate permutations but searches for a specific swappable pair within the given permutation. No other complete_search subtype matches better.
